narrative.overview: The console is a civil-protection alert ladder, not a card grid. The worst current point status fills a full-width signal band; points sit on rungs in solid signal fields. Everything else is a quiet bulletin of off-white ground, ink type, hairlines and square corners.
keyCharacteristics: Worst status owns the screen (band), points live on a ladder of solid fields.
Status is always colour plus label plus drawn glyph, never colour alone.
Condensed uppercase headings, huge tabular numerals, plain Barlow body.
Neutral ink for everything that is not point status.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and hatch mean point status and nothing else. Work-order priority and step indicators, buttons, and chrome stay in neutral ink.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status shows a colour, a text label and a drawn glyph, also on map markers.

rules.name: The Condensed-Is-Signage Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is for headings, folios and numerals; running text and form controls are Barlow.

rules.name: The Flat-Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with 1px line borders or the 4px KPI top rule, never shadows.

dos: Do pair every status with colour, label and drawn glyph.
Do keep priority, step and chrome in neutral ink.
Do keep corners square, surfaces flat, borders 1px.
Do keep motion at 180 ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), only for status changes.
Do size touch targets to at least 44 px.
Do write styles in component stylesheets or classes: no inline style attributes; component styles use a per-request nonce.
Do bundle fonts locally; no external CDNs.
donts: Don't use green, amber, red or hatch for anything but point status.
Don't show Sin datos as 0 or a flat colour.
Don't add shadows, rounded corners, gradients or glassy surfaces.
Don't set style attributes or [style] bindings in templates.
Don't imitate official Ayuntamiento seals, logos or colours.
